rounds.name: high_water_on
rounds.quote: The high-water float switch closes when the water in the pit is above the high-water mark.

rounds.name: current_on
rounds.quote: The motor current relay closes when the motor is drawing running current.

rounds.name: flow_on
rounds.quote: The discharge flow switch closes when water is moving in the discharge pipe.

rounds.name: thermal_off
rounds.quote: The thermal switch in the motor winding opens when the winding is overheated.

rounds.name: failed_start
rounds.quote: If the high-water float switch is closed and the motor current relay is not closed, the pump has failed to start and the pit may overflow.
During the weekly test the operator runs the pump with the pit empty for up to one minute. While the weekly test is in progress, running with no discharge flow is expected and is not a fault.

rounds.name: dry_run
rounds.quote: If the motor current relay is closed and the discharge flow switch is not closed, the pump is running dry or the discharge is blocked.

Water cannot move in the discharge pipe unless the motor is drawing current. If the discharge flow switch is closed while the motor current relay is open, one of the two instruments is faulty and both must be inspected.

rounds.name: instruments_faulty
rounds.quote: Water cannot move in the discharge pipe unless the motor is drawing current. If the discharge flow switch is closed while the motor current relay is open, one of the two instruments is faulty and both must be inspected.

rounds.name: overheating
rounds.quote: If the thermal switch has opened, the motor is overheated and the pump must be stopped.

rounds.name: report_failure
rounds.quote: A pump that has failed to start must be reported to maintenance immediately.

rounds.name: stop_pump
rounds.quote: Running dry destroys the shaft seal within minutes, so the pump must be stopped.

rounds.name: keep_running
rounds.quote: When the high-water float switch is closed, the pump should be running. When the float switch is open and no other signal is present, the pump is idle and no action is needed.
Stopping the pump takes priority over reporting to maintenance, and reporting to maintenance takes priority over normal running.
